name: coding-rules-guard
description: Risk-routed coding workflow with evidence-first validation, executable phase gates, and honest impact disclosure.

interface.shortDescription: FAST/FULL 分流，只加载当前阶段。
interface.longDescription: Coding Rules Guard routes low-risk work through a short FAST path, escalates cross-layer or high-risk work to FULL, and uses a bundled state validator to enforce write scope, evidence, impact, and delivery gates. Delegation is risk-based rather than mandatory for every write.
interface.defaultPrompt: Choose FAST or FULL, load only the current coding-rules phase, keep writes inside the declared scope, run the smallest discriminating real check, and disclose known or unverified impacts honestly.
